tools.name: list_card_designs
tools.description: List the occasions ShipNote makes postcards for, and the card designs available for one occasion, each with the id that create_draft accepts as design. Read-only: it saves nothing.

tools.name: quote_price
tools.description: Price for printing, stamping and mailing a number of ShipNote postcards within the US. Read-only: it saves nothing and charges nothing.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Save a DRAFT of postcards, from a single card to one person (e.g. "send a thank-you postcard to my aunt") to a whole registry or guest list, and return a link where the sender adds their return address, reviews every card, and pays on shipnote.co. This tool never mails a card and never charges anyon

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "create_draft" is 1121 chars, far longer than this server's median (180). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "claude" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_draft · Public sink: create_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_draft · Public sink: create_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
